<style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;600;700&display=swap');
        body { margin: 0; background-color: #000; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #fff; overflow-x: hidden; }
        #map { height: 100vh; width: 100vw; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 10; }
        
        .view-section { display: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.5s ease-in-out; }
        .view-active { display: flex; opacity: 1; }
        .scrollable-view { position: relative; min-height: 100vh; width: 100vw; z-index: 50; }
        
        .glass-panel { background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(25px); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); box-shadow: 10px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
        
        .custom-popup .leaflet-popup-content-wrapper { background: #0f1115; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #1f2937; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); padding: 4px; }
        .custom-popup .leaflet-popup-tip { background: #0f1115; border-bottom: 1px solid #1f2937; border-right: 1px solid #1f2937; }
        .custom-popup .leaflet-popup-close-button { color: #9ca3af !important; margin-top: 8px; margin-right: 8px; transition: 0.2s; }
        .custom-popup .leaflet-popup-close-button:hover { color: #fff !important; }

        .video-bg { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100vh; object-fit: cover; z-index: -2; }
        .video-overlay { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100vh; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); z-index: -1; }

        .dropdown-content { display: none; position: absolute; right: 0; top: 40px; background: rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 8px; width: 240px; text-align: left; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
        .dropdown-content.show { display: block; }
        .dropdown-item { padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 13px; color: #ddd; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
        .dropdown-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #fff; }
        .modal { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 99999; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(5px); align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        .modal.show { display: flex; }
        
        .tab-btn { border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #666; transition: 0.2s; }
        .tab-btn.active { border-bottom: 2px solid #10b981; color: #fff; }
        .tab-content { display: none; }
        .tab-content.active { display: block; }

        .leaflet-control-geocoder { background: #0f1115 !important; border: 1px solid #1f2937 !important; color: #fff !important; border-radius: 8px !important; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) !important; }
        .leaflet-control-geocoder-icon { filter: invert(1); }
        .leaflet-control-geocoder-form input { color: #fff !important; background: transparent !important; }
        .leaflet-control-geocoder-alternatives { background: #0f1115 !important; border-top: 1px solid #1f2937 !important; }
        .leaflet-control-geocoder-alternatives li a { color: #ccc !important; }
        .leaflet-control-geocoder-alternatives li a:hover { background: #1f2937 !important; color: #fff !important; }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #374151; border-radius: 10px; }
        
        @keyframes slideIn { from { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } }
        .toast-enter { animation: slideIn 0.3s forwards; }
    </style>
